isolated build-network CIDR and mTLS or L4 lease-enforcement sidecar
compile-worker leaf issuance and trusted inventory registration
exact CHOST, CPU feature, network-zone and project trust-domain policy
reviewed non-small C or C++ package allowlist and slot count
matching local-only and distcc artifact, ABI, install and GUI evidence
